source: docs/research/shots-cinematography.md §5.0-§5.4 (checked 2026-09-29), transcribed verbatim; ids per vsp/creative_vocab.py

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Frame-0 hands mid-action
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Start using the product before you hit record and trim so frame 0 is already mid-motion, hands and product filling the lower two-thirds.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Close-up, slightly high angle, subtle push-in: hands already mid-motion using {product} on {setting}, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Result shown first
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Film the finished result first (the foam, the clean seat, the styled hair) in a steady close-up with the product at the edge of frame.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Close-up, eye level, slow push-in on {result} with {product} at the frame edge, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Problem at its worst
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Hold the phone at chest height over the real mess or failure and drift in slightly as you start recording; do not tidy first.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Medium shot, high angle, handheld phone look: {problem} at its worst in {setting}, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Split-screen before/after
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: In the edit, put the matched BEFORE (left) and AFTER (right) clips side by side, both shot from the same taped phone spot, lens and light.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Not generated: split-screen built in the edit from two real matched clips.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: POV hands using the product
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Hold the phone at your eye line pointing down at your hands and use the product as a first-timer would, both hands in frame.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: First-person POV close-up, handheld: two hands use {product} with one simple motion, {setting}, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Reaction with product in frame
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Frame chest-up with the product or result in the lower third and film a genuine first reaction without speaking.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Medium close-up, eye level, handheld: {persona} reacts with raised eyebrows to {product} held in the lower third, no speech, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Text-first card over moving B-roll
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Film 3 s of slow push-in on the product (or the concept's subject) and add the 3-word card in the edit, inside the safe zone.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Close-up, slow push-in on {product} on {setting}, {light}, clean negative space in the upper-middle frame for a card added later.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Unboxing mid-open
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Shoot top-down with the box already half-open when you hit record, and keep the real tape and flap sounds.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Overhead close-up: a box lid lifts to reveal {product} inside, hands only at the frame edge, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Side-by-side with the alternative
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Put the product and the old alternative (brand taped over) on one surface under one light and pan slowly from the alternative to the product.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Medium shot, eye level, slow pan left to right from an unbranded {alt} to {product} on {setting}, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Day-N selfie check-in
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Film a front-camera check-in at the same spot and time each day, arm's length, eyes in the upper third; the Day N marker goes on in the edit.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Selfie-style medium close-up, handheld front camera: {persona} in {setting}, {light}, glancing at the lens.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Macro texture / sound moment
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Switch to macro (or 2x from about 10 cm), lock focus and exposure on the texture, and record the real sound up close.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Extreme close-up, macro lens, very slow push-in across the texture of {material}, shallow depth of field, {light}; sound design: {sound}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Label / spec detail
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Tilt slowly down the real label or spec plate, holding each readable line for a full second.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Image-to-video from the real label photo only: slow tilt down, no other motion, letters unchanged.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Talking head, direct to camera
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Prop the phone at eye height about an arm's length away, face the window, lock exposure on your face and say the line to the lens.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Medium close-up, eye level, static: {persona} speaks to the lens in {setting}, {light}. {name} says: {line}

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: To camera, product in hand
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Hold the product beside your face at chin height, front toward the lens, and deliver the line with the phone on a stand.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Medium close-up, eye level, slow push-in: {persona} holds {product} at chin height, front toward camera. {name} says: {line}

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Selfie walk-and-talk
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Walk slowly with the front camera at arm's length just above eye level, stabilisation on, talking in the present tense.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Selfie-style tracking shot, medium close-up: {persona} walks slowly through {setting} talking to the lens, {light}. {name} says: {line}

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Medium-wide CTA to camera
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Step back so your hips and the product on the counter are in frame and push the phone in slightly while you say the comment prompt.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Medium-wide, eye level, slow push-in: {persona} beside {product} on {setting} speaks to camera, {light}. {name} says: {line}

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Reaction cutaway, three-quarter
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Move the phone 45 degrees off your eye line and film a silent nod or look at the result as it happens.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Medium close-up, three-quarter angle, static: {persona} looks down at {subject} and nods slightly, eyes off-lens, no speech, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Profile look at product or result
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Film side-on at face height while you look at the product, with the window lighting the far side of your face.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Medium close-up, profile, static: {persona} studies {product} in {setting}, soft side light.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Jump-cut punch-in
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Record the talking head in 4K and punch in 1.3-1.5x in the edit on the key word; nothing extra to film.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Edit-only: crop the previous talking-head clip 1.3x on the emphasised word; no new generation.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Candid handheld confession
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Hold the phone yourself, a little closer than your talking-head framing, and say the flaw in one unrehearsed take.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Not generated: confession is human-only and an AI presenter cannot claim experience.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Over-shoulder demo
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Have a helper, or a tall stand behind you, film over your shoulder while you do the real task start to finish.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Over-the-shoulder medium shot, handheld: hands use {product} with one simple motion on {setting}, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Top-down hands demo
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Mount the phone flat above the table, have your hands enter from the bottom of frame, and film one step per clip.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Overhead medium shot, static: hands enter from the bottom and perform one step with {product} on {setting}, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Product doing its job, hands out
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Frame only the working end (whisk in milk, brush on the seat) with hands cropped out and push in slowly as the effect builds.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Close-up, slightly high angle, slow push-in: the working end of {product} {action} in {medium}, hands out of frame, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Feature or step insert (press, twist, click)
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Film the single finger action in a tight close-up with its sound, one attempt per clip.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Not generated: finger-level manipulation of small parts; use the fallback.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Feature call-out on a hero shot
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Film a slow push toward the feature and add the circle or arrow in the edit.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Image-to-video from the real product photo: slow push-in toward the {feature}, no other motion.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Time-lapse of a slow process
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Lock the phone on a stand in Time-lapse mode for the whole slow process and do not touch the frame until it ends.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Time-lapse, static camera, high angle: {process} unfolds over the shot in {setting}, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Slow-motion hero moment
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Shoot the fast moment (pour, splash, spritz, fabric drop) in Slo-mo at 120 fps or more on a stand, then ramp into slow motion in the edit.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Close-up, eye level, slow motion: {fast_action} with {product}, droplets and motion detail visible, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Pour, pump or dispense close-up
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Frame the receiving cup or palm and pour or pump once, slowly, with the sound close to the mic.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Close-up, high angle, static: {liquid} pours slowly from {product} into {vessel}, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Hand enters and picks up
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Start on the product alone and let your hand enter within half a second to grab it, so the opening already moves.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Close-up, eye level, static: a hand enters from the frame bottom and lifts {product} (large, easy grip) off {setting}, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Turn in hand under window light
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Face the window and rotate the product slowly in your hand so the light travels across front, side and back.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Not generated: in-hand rotation makes the model invent unseen sides; use the fallback.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Orbit around the product
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Put the product on a lazy Susan, or walk the phone in a slow half-circle around it at product height.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Close-up, three-quarter angle, slow tracking arc around {product} on {setting}, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Product hero, slow push-in
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Set the product on a clean surface with side window light and slide the phone slowly toward it along the table.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Image-to-video from the real product photo: slow dolly in, no other motion.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Flat lay: what is included
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Lay out the product and everything in the box in a grid and record top-down while lowering the phone slightly.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Image-to-video from the real flat-lay photo: slow overhead push-in, objects stay still.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Product in its real setting
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Show where the product actually lives (counter, nightstand, car door) with a slow sideways slide of the phone.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Medium-wide, eye level, slow dolly right: {product} in place in {setting}, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Establishing wide
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: From the doorway, pan slowly across the room or place to set the time and location (morning kitchen, gym, car).
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Wide establishing shot, eye level, slow pan across {setting} at {time_of_day}, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Matched BEFORE
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Tape the phone's spot, note the lens and time of day, turn off filters and beauty mode, and record the BEFORE with a clock or date in frame.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Not generated: before/after evidence must be real footage.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Matched AFTER
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Return the phone to the taped spot with the same lens, light and time of day and record the AFTER with the date visible.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Not generated: before/after evidence must be real footage.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Match-cut transformation
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: End the BEFORE clip on a fast swipe past the lens, start the AFTER clip with the same swipe from the same taped spot, and cut mid-motion.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Edit-only: transition between two real matched clips.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Timestamped proof insert
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Film the real reading (timer, scale, battery percentage, phone clock) in one steady close-up held long enough to read.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Not generated: readable numbers and evidence must be real footage.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Phone-screen insert
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Screen-record, or film the screen straight-on with brightness up and notifications off; never a product-page screenshot for TikTok Shop.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Not generated: UI text is unreliable; use a real screen recording.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Stress or torture test
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Do the real test once in one unbroken take (drop, spill, stretch) with a second phone catching a wider angle.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Not generated: AI outcomes succeed too often and cannot prove durability.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Rejected alternatives line-up
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Line up the products you gave up on (brands turned away or taped over), the winner last, and pan along them.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Medium shot, eye level, slow pan along a row of unbranded {category} items ending on {product}, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Toss-aside cutaway
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Drop the old item into a drawer or box and whip the phone toward the new product as it lands.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Not generated: thrown-object physics; use the fallback.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Counting points on fingers
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Frame waist-up so your hand is in shot and count the point on your fingers as you say it.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Not generated: finger counts render wrong; use talking-head-mcu with the number as an edit overlay.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Prop explainer
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Hold the prop (ingredient, receipt, sketch) close to the lens and steady while you explain it.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Close-up, eye level, slow push-in: a hand holds {prop} steady toward camera, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Insert of what the line is about
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Film a tight close-up of the object the sentence mentions (snack drawer, notebook, alarm) while you say it.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Close-up, slightly high angle, slow push-in on {object} in {setting}, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Green-screen explainer
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Use the app's green-screen effect with a real source (chart, article, product photo) behind you and point to it.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Medium close-up, eye level, static: {persona} speaks to camera in front of a plain backdrop, a real image is composited later. {name} says: {line}

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: POV walk-in
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Walk into the room at chest height with the rear camera, stabilisation on, ending on the spot where the routine happens.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: First-person POV tracking shot walking into {setting} toward {spot}, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Routine step, wide
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Place the phone at waist height at 45 degrees and slide it slowly while you do the routine step in real time.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Medium-wide, three-quarter angle, slow dolly: {persona} does {step} in {setting}, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Mirror selfie
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Film in a clean mirror with the phone at chest height and the product or outfit centred.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Not generated: mirror reflections and the phone in hand break consistency; use the fallback.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Low-angle result held to lens
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Hold the phone slightly below chest height and bring the result toward the lens while your face stays in the upper third.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Medium close-up, low angle, slow push-in: {persona} holds {result} toward camera, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Comment keyword typed
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Screen-record typing the keyword into the comment box on your own post, with other handles out of frame.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Not generated: typed UI text is unreliable; screen-record it.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: End card on product hero
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Reuse the hero push-in and add the CTA card in the edit, product centred above the bottom caption band.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Image-to-video from the real product photo: slow push-in, clear space above the product for a card added later.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Loop-back final frame
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: End on the same framing, position and motion as frame 0 so the jump back to the start is invisible.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Use the frame-0 still as both first and last frame (loop); slow dolly out that settles on the opening composition.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Whip-pan transition
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Whip the phone sideways at the end of one clip and the same way at the start of the next, then cut mid-blur.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Medium shot, fast whip pan to the right ending on {subject} in {setting}, motion blur, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Speed-ramp into the reveal
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Shoot the move toward the reveal at 60 fps or more and ramp from fast to slow on the frame where the result appears.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Close-up, fast handheld push-in that slows sharply as {result} comes into view, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Lens-cover wipe
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Cover the lens with your palm at the end of one clip and uncover it at the start of the next, cutting on the dark frame.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Close-up, a palm moves toward the lens until the frame goes dark, {light}.

SHOT_LIBRARY.name: Voice-over on hands B-roll
SHOT_LIBRARY.human_instructions: Film your hands handling the product loosely for about 10 s per clip; the talking-head audio runs on top.
SHOT_LIBRARY.ai_prompt: Close-up, high angle, handheld: relaxed hands rest on and gently touch {product} on {setting}, no speech, {light}.

frame0.product_concepts: frame-0 shot needs 'product', or its visual_type is result-reveal or before-after-split
frame0.no_product_concepts: frame 0 shows the subject, problem or day counter

loop_ending.rule: last shot is loop-return-frame (inherits frame 0's scale, angle and subject) or repeats frame 0's shot id; the last spoken line may run into the first

render_phrase_for_move_id.static: split into sub-shots of 3.5 s or less

gemini-omni-flash-1.1.refs: images + up to 3 video refs of 3 s or less
gemini-omni-flash-1.1.notes: multi-shot by default; no negative-prompt param

veo-3.1.refs: up to 3 asset images (8 s only)
veo-3.1.notes: first+last frame; audio always on; 24 fps

ai.generate_length_rule: shortest allowed clip length at least shot duration + 1.0 s of handles; trim in the edit
prompt_order: subject: locked persona or product text
audio: SFX/ambience; dialogue after a colon
ai.prompt_suffix: Single continuous shot, no scene cuts. One camera move only. No on-screen text, captions, logos or watermarks.
ai.inserts_without_persona: shots whose needs lack 'face' must not include the persona description; add 'hands only, face out of frame' when hands appear
ai.persona_consistency: same 1-3 reference stills in every shot + identical description text + same seed; never re-describe the face when a reference is loaded
ai.product_consistency: real product photos (front, side, back, detail); image-to-video from the real packshot for hero, label and end-card shots; slow moves only over labels
ai.hands: large-object grasps only, contact 2 s or less; no finger-level manipulation, counting, typing or writing
ai.physics: no drops, throws, snap-fits, stacking or fast motion; slow pours and foam are med risk
ai.proof: AI shots never serve as evidence: EVIDENCE BEAT, matched before/after, stress tests and timestamps use real footage, or become text cards
ai.presenter_ai_substitution: replace ai_risk=high with ai_fallback (follow the chain to med or low); at most 2 consecutive med shots; low-risk shots at least 30% of runtime
ai.loop: pass the frame-0 still as first and last frame (Omni sources syntax, Veo first+last frame) or use Luma loop
ai.qa: run a vision-model check on every clip for hands, labels, identity and extra cuts before assembly

assembly: 1. concatenate each beat's shots in beat order; trim from the end of a beat's list when its window is shorter than the sum of min durations
2. presenter=ai: replace ai_risk=high ids by following ai_fallback until med/low
3. if a shot repeats the previous id, or breaks max_consecutive_same_scale / max_consecutive_talking_head, take the beat's first alt (ai_risk != high when presenter=ai) that fixes it
4. presenter=ai and format=transformation: require brand-supplied real before/after footage, else route the script to demo
5. apply SHOT_RULES.hard (frame0, human_presence, loop_ending, product share) and log any rule still failing

SHOOT_PLAN_RULES.group_rule: shots with the same setup_key form one setup; inside a setup shoot wide to tight (WS, MWS, MS, MCU, CU, ECU) so the phone moves in one direction

setup_order.name: pristine product
setup_order.why: packaging and product are untouched only once

setup_order.name: BEFORE states
setup_order.why: tape the phone spot now; the AFTER reuses it

setup_order.name: A-roll talking head
setup_order.why: record the whole script top to bottom, then the cutaways at the same light

setup_order.name: AFTER states
setup_order.why: same taped spot, lens, light and time of day as step 2

setup_order.name: screens
setup_order.why: screen-record after posting a draft; notifications off

setup_order.name: transitions and pick-ups
setup_order.why: loop-return-frame is shot right after frame 0 when possible, at the same setup

a_roll.phone_height: eye level, arm's length, on a stand

camera_settings.lock: AE/AF lock on the subject at every setup
camera_settings.stabilisation: on; handheld moves stay smooth (TikTok Shop)
camera_settings.lens: 1x main; macro mode or 2x for ECU; no digital zoom past 2x

window-key-45.how: face a window at about 45 degrees; overhead lights off; no direct sun

window-plus-bounce.how: window key plus a white card or foam board on the shadow side

soft-overhead.how: diffused daylight or a lamp through white fabric; keep the phone's shadow out of frame

side-raking.how: one low side light so texture casts small shadows; dark background

warm-practical.how: a warm lamp as key, daylight blocked so colour temperatures do not mix

ring-light-front.how: only when no glossy product or glasses are in frame (ring reflections)

before_after_protocol: tape the phone or stand position and note height, lens and zoom
same light preset and time of day; flash off
same background and framing; subject in the same pose and distance
clock, date card or phone clock in frame
no filters or beauty mode; the same edit grade on both clips
hold each state 1.5 s or more; show the AFTER from the same spot before any closer shot
props_checklist_rules: every shot needing 'product' adds the product; add a second unit if the shot list has stress-test-action or a messy demo
unboxing-mid-open adds a sealed box; film step 1 before opening anything
comparison-side-by-side and rejection-lineup add the alternatives with brand marks taped over or turned away
pour-dispense-cu, product-operating-cu and slowmo-hero-moment add the consumable (milk, water, cream) and a wipe cloth
matched-before, matched-after and timestamp-proof-insert add a clock or date card and floor or table tape
shots needing 'screen' add a second phone or screen recorder, a clean home screen and notifications off; never a product-page screenshot for TikTok Shop
shots needing 'location' list the location and time of day; shots needing 'face' list the wardrobe (one outfit per shoot day; change outfits per day only for day-counter stories)
kit, always: phone stand or tripod, white card, lens cloth, tape; lazy Susan if product-hero-orbit is used; overhead mount if overhead shots are used
broll_checklist_rules: each VO line longer than 2 s gets an insert showing its noun (insert-object-detail or a product close-up)
each demo step gets two angles (e.g. pov-hands-first-use + over-shoulder-demo)
record live sound on every B-roll clip; it plays under the voice
shoot one spare hero push-in and one spare reaction per setup for the variant cuts

order: approve persona reference sheet (1-3 stills) and product reference photos
render low-risk image-to-video shots first (hero, flat lay, macro, lifestyle, inserts)
render presenter shots with identical persona text + same seed
apply ai_fallback swaps and re-render any clip that fails QA
assemble; add all text, captions and cards in the edit
ai_render_plan.on_repeated_failure: swap to ai_fallback, then to text-card-over-motion
